class.name: PhotoMode
class.brief_description: Lets the player stop the game and take pictures of it.
class.description: Open it from the game's pause menu: the game stops, its HUD goes, and the player flies a camera round the scene from where the game's camera was, sets the field of view, roll, focus distance, background blur and exposure, adds a vignette or film grain, and takes photos. They're saved as PNG files in [code]photo_mode/photos_folder[/code] in Project Settings ([code]user://photos[/code] by default). [codeblock] func _on_photo_mode_pressed() -> void: PhotoMode.open() [/codeblock] The camera sees as the game's did: its environment, layers and compositor effects. It stays within [code]photo_mode/max_distance[/code] (20 meters by default) of where it started, so players can't see past the level. With a mouse and keyboard: hold the right button to look, WASD to move, Q and E for down and up, Shift to go faster, H to hide the panel, Escape to close. With a controller: the sticks to move and look, the triggers for down and up, A takes a photo, Y hides the panel, B or Start closes.

method.name: close
method.description: Gives the game back: its camera, its HUD and its pause as they were before [method open].

method.name: is_open
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while photo mode is open.

method.name: open
method.description: Stops the game and opens photo mode at its window's 3D camera. Returns [code]false[/code] if the window has no 3D camera.

method.name: take_photo
method.description: Takes a photo without the panel in it, as the player's [b]Take photo[/b] button does. Await the signal for a [Dictionary]: [code]ok[/code], the saved file's [code]path[/code], or on failure [code]error[/code] ([code]"not_open"[/code], [code]"not_saved"[/code] or [code]"closed"[/code]) and [code]message[/code].

signal.name: closed
signal.description: Emitted when photo mode closes and the game carries on.

signal.name: opened
signal.description: Emitted when photo mode opens and the game stops.

signal.name: photo_taken
signal.description: Emitted when a photo is saved, with the file it was saved to.
